dialogues.speaker: Cardboard and Graffiti
dialogues.text: (A piece of cardboard pinned beneath a stone, bearing the face of an ordinary Jack Frost. It seems to have once been used by some creature as a disguise.)

dialogues.speaker: Cardboard and Graffiti
dialogues.text: (The fact that it was left here suggests its former owner no longer has any need for disguises, and is now free to stride toward a new future.)
